title: Strength Programming
promise: Build a training plan that actually progresses.
summary: Most people who lift stop getting stronger within a year, not because they lack effort but because nothing in their training is designed to go up over time. This skill gives you the structure that fixes that: how much to do, how to arrange it around a real schedule, and exactly what to change when a lift stalls. Written for adults with jobs, not athletes with afternoons free.

starters: My bench has been stuck at the same weight for two months
